the_problem.description: Anime/C-drama subtitles are frequently misaligned with video
common_causes: constant_offset — subs from different release, few seconds off
progressive_drift — video re-encoded at different framerate, error grows over episode

user_documented_case.symptom: subtitles get worse over the course of the episode
user_documented_case.actual_cause: 0.9% progressive drift — subs are 1.009x too fast relative to video

what_other_players_do.approach: auto-detect media offset only via VAD onset correlation
VAD + FFT cross-correlation + golden-section framerate search

what_we_built.reasons: ffsubsync is the most-validated open-source subtitle sync tool

algorithm_selection.why_cross_correlation: Scoring every alignment shift IS a convolution. Compute with FFT in O(n log n) over all shifts at once.

structure.sync/SpeechDetector.kt: multi-feature VAD: energy + variance + zero-crossing rate

lock_gates.name: containment_min
lock_gates.meaning: most audio speech inside subtitle cues

lock_gates.name: cross_half_validation
lock_gates.meaning: offset found on first half replicates on second half

vad_features.variance: syllable modulation, separates speech from music, weight=0.3

real_content_test.name: realsim_ep31.py + ffmpeg silencedetect
real_content_test.validation: user confirmed visually on 2026-08-25 that corrected subs work

dead_ends_and_mistakes.name: 10x_bin_mapping_bug
dead_ends_and_mistakes.symptom: sync never locked even on synthetic test
dead_ends_and_mistakes.root_cause: frames were 10ms but bin formula divided by 100*ALIGN_BIN=10, making audio 10x too dense for the subtitle track
dead_ends_and_mistakes.lesson: unit math at boundaries is the most common bug class

dead_ends_and_mistakes.name: off_main_thread_player_access
dead_ends_and_mistakes.symptom: every video failed to play, no error visible
dead_ends_and_mistakes.root_cause: AudioSyncProcessor called player.currentPosition from audio thread on every 10ms window. ExoPlayer throws IllegalStateException off main thread.
dead_ends_and_mistakes.fix: sample-count clock: posMs = startPositionMs + totalFrames*1000/sampleRate, set from main thread via onPositionDiscontinuity
dead_ends_and_mistakes.lesson: Media3 AudioProcessor has strict threading — never touch the player from it

dead_ends_and_mistakes.name: energy_vad_inadequate_for_C_drama
dead_ends_and_mistakes.symptom: engine refused to lock on real Growling Tiger 2 audio (score 0.12, margin 0.003)
dead_ends_and_mistakes.root_cause: energy alone can't separate Mandarin dialogue from traditional Chinese music (both high-energy, both sustained)
dead_ends_and_mistakes.fix: improved VAD with 3 features (energy + variance + ZCR) — still insufficient for C-drama; ffmpeg's silencedetect is the right tool
dead_ends_and_mistakes.lesson: the algorithm is correct; the VAD is the bottleneck. production needs ffmpeg-style onset detection, not energy thresholds

dead_ends_and_mistakes.name: 1d_offset_search_inadequate
dead_ends_and_mistakes.symptom: no significant correlation peak on real audio
dead_ends_and_mistakes.root_cause: error was growing over time (progressive drift) — no single constant offset was correct anywhere
dead_ends_and_mistakes.fix: 2D search over both offset and speed factor simultaneously. best solution: alpha=1.009, beta=-0.13s, 71% match rate
dead_ends_and_mistakes.lesson: the formulation must match the failure mode. frame-rate mismatch is a 2D problem

dead_ends_and_mistakes.name: kotlinOptions_DSL_removed
dead_ends_and_mistakes.root_cause: Kotlin 2.4 / AGP 9 removed the kotlinOptions DSL
dead_ends_and_mistakes.lesson: verify API availability per language/AGP version

dead_ends_and_mistakes.name: addAudioProcessor_does_not_exist
dead_ends_and_mistakes.symptom: no compile error but no audio processor wired
dead_ends_and_mistakes.fix: inject via DefaultAudioSink.Builder.setAudioProcessors(arrayOf(...)) inside buildAudioSink override of NextRenderersFactory (open class)
dead_ends_and_mistakes.lesson: read the actual interface, don't guess

dead_ends_and_mistakes.name: MediaStore.Files_query_only_by_name
dead_ends_and_mistakes.symptom: subtitles never resolved for C-dramas (video and sub filenames differ completely)
dead_ends_and_mistakes.root_cause: initial implementation used DISPLAY_NAME LIKE <basename>% which never matched
dead_ends_and_mistakes.fix: list all sub files in the same parent directory, then try exact → starts-with → first-encountered priority chain
dead_ends_and_mistakes.lesson: downloaded files have inconsistent naming; sidecar discovery should be directory-based with priority fallback

dead_ends_and_mistakes.name: no_runtime_permission_for_video
dead_ends_and_mistakes.symptom: library always empty even after granting permission
dead_ends_and_mistakes.root_cause: READ_MEDIA_VIDEO declared in manifest but never requested at runtime — Android 6+ blocks dangerous permissions silently
dead_ends_and_mistakes.fix: runtime permission request via ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions + PermissionGate UI
dead_ends_and_mistakes.lesson: always check Android version + dangerous permissions at runtime

tools/drift_sim.py.status: finds 1.009 speed factor on Growling Tiger 2

core/media/sync/SpeechCorrelator.kt.role: 1:1 port of the Python sim — same math, same gates

core/media/sync/SpeechDetector.kt.role: multi-feature VAD: energy + variance + zero-crossing rate
core/media/sync/SpeechDetector.kt.limitation: still inferior to ffmpeg's silencedetect for C-drama content

core/media/sync/DriftTracker.kt.role: collects offset samples, fits least-squares line

core/media/sync/AudioSyncProcessor.kt.threading: audio thread only; never touches the player

feature/player/PlaybackEngine.kt.audio_processor_injection: override buildAudioSink on NextRenderersFactory (open class) to inject via DefaultAudioSink.Builder.setAudioProcessors(arrayOf(syncProcessor))

app/PlayerActivity.kt.subtitle_resolution: findSidecarSubtitle scans all sub files in video's parent directory with priority: exact match → starts-with → first found
app/PlayerActivity.kt.render_loop: 100ms tick reads player position, maps through drift correction, finds cue, updates Compose state

what_works_today_v0.3.0: Subtitles resolve from any file in video's directory
Drift-corrected SRT files generated for all 17 Growling Tiger 2 episodes (use in MPC-HC/VLC — works perfectly)
Engine code is in place and compiles; not validated to auto-lock on real C-drama content
what_is_missing: Live auto-sync on real C-drama content — in-app VAD doesn't match ffmpeg's quality
PiP, background playback, sleep timer, zoom modes
Redesigned M3 library UI is written but not built or pushed

to_make_live_auto_sync_work.recommended_approach: ffsubsync model — bundle ffmpeg via nextlib, run offline fingerprint pass on first play
implementation_steps: 1. When a video first opens, fork a background job
2. ffmpeg silencedetect to extract speech onsets
3. Run joint speed+offset search using the Python algorithm in Kotlin
4. Store result (offset, speedFactor) in Room per video
5. Apply on first frame of playback; cache makes re-watch instant
to_make_live_auto_sync_work.estimated_effort: 1-2 days for an experienced Android dev

reproduction_steps.generate_corrected_subs: apply new_time = old_time * 1.009 + (-0.33) to each timestamp

open_questions: Does the in-app live processor ever lock on real C-drama content? (Unknown — never tested on device.)
Should we implement ffmpeg-style offline fingerprinting as the path forward? (Recommended.)
Should we add a manual 'Load corrected subs' button so users can drop a .SYNCED.srt file in? (Easy, useful.)

glossary.VAD: Voice Activity Detection — decides which audio is speech vs silence/music
glossary.offset_beta: Constant time difference between audio and subs. Positive = subs late.
glossary.speed_factor_alpha: Multiplicative correction. 1.009 = subs are 0.9% too fast.
glossary.cross_correlation: Sliding-window dot product. Scores every possible alignment shift at once.
glossary.containment: Fraction of detected speech mass that falls inside subtitle cues. True alignment ~0.9; chance ~0.5.
glossary.drift: Progressive accumulation of error over episode. Caused by frame-rate mismatch.
glossary.histogram_voting: Each detected speech onset votes for the offset that aligns it with a cue start. The true offset collects all votes.
glossary.ICP: Iterative Closest Point — refines offset by matching each onset to its nearest cue start and taking the median residual.

final_recommendation: Bundle ffmpeg-style onset detection in-app via nextlib. The math is done; the gap is a VAD strong enough for real content. All other engine pieces (correlator, drift tracker, threading, persistence) are validated and working.
